scope.included: The 16 regular Grade 8 curriculum designs currently embedded by the official KICD Grade Eight Designs manifest.
scope.excluded: Adapted Grade 8 designs for learners with hearing, physical, or visual impairments are out of corpus scope and are referenced only under excluded_scope.

identityPolicy.canonicalId: Stable, grade-independent canonical learning-area identifier used by normalization.
identityPolicy.subjectCode: Stable subject code; equal to canonicalId for this catalog.
identityPolicy.aliases: Evidence-supported equivalent labels only. An alias does not create another document identity or permit a regular/SNE source merge.
identityPolicy.catalogDocumentClass: The document's role in the 16-document regular manifest: common_required, religious_education_alternative, or elective_language.
identityPolicy.formalRole: Timetable slot and selection rule are stored separately from document identity.
identityPolicy.uniqueness: Every regular source document has one unique canonicalId and subjectCode. Kenya Sign Language is recorded only as an excluded learner-context boundary and is not synthesized into the subjects array.

regularCatalogAccounting.documentClassEquation: 8 common required designs + 3 religious education alternatives + 5 elective language designs = 16 regular index documents

kiswahiliOrKenyaSignLanguage.handling: Do not invent or merge a seventeenth regular source. Keep the official hearing-impairment Kenya Sign Language design outside this regular corpus while retaining its learner-context relationship to the slot.

sneBoundary.validationRule: No HI, PI, VI, Kenya Sign Language, Braille Skills, or prevocational document may be counted among or merged into the 16 regular Grade Eight source records.

authoritativeIndex.title: Grade Eight Designs
authoritativeIndex.selectionEvidence: Each included document is a Google Drive preview embedded under its exact subject label in the rendered KICD manifest.
authoritativeIndex.metadataEvidence: File names, page counts, and byte sizes are from the corresponding embedded Google Drive viewer metadata.

sourcePolicy.currentSource: Use the Google Drive preview embedded by the authoritative KICD Grade Eight Designs manifest.
sourcePolicy.statusPolicy: An embedded Drive preview is current for this catalog because the verified official KICD manifest selects it.
sourcePolicy.mirrorHandling: Legacy or stale KICD mirrors are evidence only and must not replace the current embedded preview.
sourcePolicy.filenameDateHandling: Dates and revision labels parsed from filenames remain filename evidence and are not Drive creation, modification, publication, or independently verified internal revision timestamps.
sourcePolicy.normalizedTitleHandling: subject and normalizedTitle are normalized curriculum labels; title is the exact Google Drive viewer filename.
sourcePolicy.unknownMetadata: Unverified publication dates, raw-PDF hashes, embedded PDF metadata, and Drive timestamps are null or omitted.

specialNeedsEducationScope.reason: Adapted Grade 8 designs for learners with hearing, physical, or visual impairments are out of corpus scope and are referenced only under excluded_scope.

manifests.title: HI Grade 8 Designs
manifests.evidence: The official KICD manifest lists 8 embedded Grade 8 designs for learners with hearing impairment.
manifests.exclusionReason: Adapted SNE documents are outside this regular Grade 8 corpus.

manifests.title: PI Grade 8 Designs
manifests.evidence: The official KICD manifest lists 8 embedded Grade 8 designs for learners with physical impairment.
manifests.exclusionReason: Adapted SNE documents are outside this regular Grade 8 corpus.

manifests.title: VI Grade 8 Designs
manifests.evidence: The official KICD manifest lists 10 embedded Grade 8 designs for learners with visual impairment.
manifests.exclusionReason: Adapted SNE documents are outside this regular Grade 8 corpus.

notes: The official manifest label 'Creative Arts' maps to the normalized subject 'Creative Arts and Sports'; both source and normalized values are retained.
The official manifest label 'Agriculture' occupies the rationalised 'Agriculture and Nutrition' curriculum slot.
CRE, HRE, and IRE are alternative pathways within one Religious Education slot, not three simultaneously required slots.
Arabic, French, German, Indigenous Languages, and Mandarin are optional-language designs, not additional core slots.
Kenya Sign Language is not a standalone regular-manifest source; its official Grade 8 design is published under the hearing-impairment SNE manifest and remains excluded from this regular corpus.
